contract.body:
THE PILL is an immersive audio experience, not medicine, therapy or a substitute for professional care.

By continuing you confirm:
1. You are at least 18 years old.
2. “Pill” and “capsule” are metaphors for sound sessions.
3. Sessions may feel intense or unsettling, including suspense, immersion and sensual or body-focused themes. Experiences vary; no specific effect is guaranteed.
4. You will not drive, operate machinery or do anything unsafe during or immediately after a session.
5. You accept responsibility for your use of the app and your wellbeing.
6. THE PILL and its creators accept no liability for emotional distress, decisions or outcomes arising from these experiences.
7. If you have a medical or psychiatric condition, consult a professional before intense sessions.

Stop the session if you feel uncomfortable.
Accept only if you agree.
describe.expect: Put on headphones when you're ready. The session follows the full length of this sound — no shortcuts, no fixed timer.
how.title: How it works
how.p1: The Pill uses binaural audio technology to create subtle rhythmic patterns in the brain.
how.p2: When you listen with headphones, each ear receives a slightly different sound frequency. Your brain perceives the difference between these two frequencies as a gentle rhythmic beat.
how.p3: Different sessions use different frequency ranges, ambient sounds, and audio patterns designed to support experiences such as relaxation, focus, sleep, energy, and mood.
how.p4: For the best experience, use stereo headphones, choose a quiet environment, and allow yourself time to fully settle into the session.
how.note1: The Pill is not a medication, medical device, or treatment method. It is not designed to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease, and it does not replace professional healthcare.
how.note2: The Pill is an entertainment and wellness app that offers sound and binaural audio–based digital experiences. Sessions in the app do not guarantee any specific medical, physical, or psychological outcome, and the experience may vary from person to person.
how.note3: By using the app, you are deemed to have accepted the User Agreement and related terms. Using The Pill and its sound experiences is entirely your choice. Users are responsible for using the app with regard to their own health, environment, and personal circumstances.
how.note4: If you feel discomfort, dizziness, nausea, intense unease, or any unexpected effect, stop the session.
how.note5: Do not use The Pill while driving, operating machinery, or in situations that require your full attention to your surroundings.
legal.privacyBody:
Last updated: 2026-03-29

THE PILL ("we", "the app") stores your profile and listening data on your device using local storage. We do not operate a backend that receives your name, favorites, history or ratings.

Data stored on device may include: display name, mood answers, listening journal, ratings, downloaded library, membership flag and language preference. We do not collect an email address.

You can delete this data anytime with Delete account in Profile. Signing out clears the active profile on this device.

Audio experiences are not medical treatment. If you connect future cloud features (streaming, accounts, payments), this policy will be updated and a public HTTPS copy will be published for App Store / Play Console.

Contact: support@thepill.app
